To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Census Bureau should be collecting item level prices and quantities and using these data to construct price and quantity indexes.

(1) the Census Bureau’s micro data are of high quality, with a low rate of missing or inconsistent information, (2) the Census Bureau micro data can be used to construct a high-quality price index that is consistent with the BLS CPI, and (3) the Census Bureau data can be used in conjunction with the BLS data to produce an improved measure of real output.
